summary: This standards-track document specifies several YANG modules that together form the core routing data model, a framework for configuring and managing a routing subsystem. Other YANG modules for specific routing protocols are expected to extend it. This is the NMDA-compatible version of the earlier model.

eli5.summary: Every router needs a notebook of directions. This is a standard notebook layout that other, more specific notebooks can build on.

how to configure routing with yang
